system.description:
You command an arsenal of spells and mystical forces.

Powers/Qualities

Assign one or more of the dice you rolled at the end of the power source step to any of these powers:

• Select from Elemental/Energy powers category

• Select from Materials powers category

• Select from Mobility powers category

• Select from Psychic powers category

• Select from Self Control powers category

Assign any remaining dice to any of these qualities:

• Select from Information qualities category

• Select from Mental qualities category

Abilities

Gain two of the following Green abilities, using two different powers.

  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.imnA8a70pkaz0abA]{Banish}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.ebJxg6qUjmPnLeYe]{Energy Jaunt}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.HF3Da8MT2unKCQ99]{Powerful Blast}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.ccfZVifaC4QubTZk]{Subdue}

Gain one of these Yellow abilities.

  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.Qnvb3r0lB1inQSRo]{Cords of Magic}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.uqmhNqGBWd5UT21Y]{Field of Energy}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.SkJ0L648OB64L2F0]{Living Bomb}
Principle

Choose an Esoteric principle.

Roll d10, d10 for personality selection.
